## Work items

Bugs (🐞 B-) and features (✨ F-) in one list, ordered by priority (`P1` → `P2` → `P3`), then actionability. Click any item heading to return to top. From 2026-11-05 a defect (behaviour that breaks something meant to work) gets a B- record here; earlier ones stayed in their F- records (owner decision).

- **Status:** 🔴 Open · 🟠 Investigate · 🟡 Implemented · 🟢 Verified · 🟣 Blocked · 🔵 Closed
- **Steps:** `effort` = remaining agent time (🟢 up to 1 h · 🟡 4 h · 🔴 8 h · 🟣 more); `estimate` = latest whole-step estimate; `actual` = effort spent so far; `h` = agent hours (owner time apart); step status is not parent acceptance.

## Other changes

Earlier reconciliations and assessments (2026-11-08 – 2026-11-12) are archived in [Reconciliation log](archive/reconciliation-2026.md#archived-other-changes-moved-from-backlogmd-on-2026-11-13).

**Harness v10.1.0 reconciliation, 2026-11-20.** Template F-085, asked from NERV on 2026-11-19: `tools/work-items.mjs` copied from v10.1.0; `docs/backlog/steps.md` and `docs/backlog/ordering.md` carried from the template diff v10.0.0..v10.1.0. Each open step now shows its Depends on and Unlocks steps in the steps table, and `check:work` warns on a blocker named only in prose. Its first run flagged B-068 → F-011 and F-012 → F-006; both are false positives (B-068's text says F-011 waits on B-068, and F-012's match is in 2026-11-13 history whose date format the warning does not split on; F-012-T03's prerequisite, F-006-T07, is closed), so nothing changed. [PR #575](https://github.com/voidbrain/nerv/pull/575).
